run.name: Flutter Entertainment plc
run.title: CP-OS host session (FLUT)
run.summary: Flutter's debt looks adequately supported but stretched: liquidity is ample and maturities are long, but total leverage of 5.28x and net leverage of 4.55x sit well above the 2.0x to 2.5x target. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Adjusted EBITDA (company definition), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt (12,313) and cash (1,708) at September 30, 2026 over LTM Adjusted EBITDA (2,331). Calculated. The Q3 release reports 4.6x on net debt of 10,656. Pre-amendment; the covenant uses a different EBITDA and net borrowings definition.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA (2,331) over LTM cash interest paid (636). Calculated.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash (Q3 10-Q `page:5`); undrawn commitment `$782 million (£590 million)` (Q3 10-Q `page:27`), including 13 reserved for guarantees. Before the October 30, 2026 amendment, which lifts the commitment to `$1.86 billion` (`page:75`); the undrawn amount after the amendment is not supplied.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Credit documents and covenant ratio values are not supplied, so covenant headroom cannot be measured.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is the company's own measure, not the covenant definition, and the last-twelve-month figure is calculated from filed annual and interim data.
